parsed.name: 晶格图形标注对象
parsed.description: 这不是独立实验硬件，而是显微图像或衍射图分析界面中的晶格图形标注对象，用于在图像上定义周期性晶格区域、掩膜或测量参考，并可交互调整 u、v 方向位置与半径。
parsed.description_en: This is not a standalone laboratory instrument but a lattice graphic overlay used in microscopy or diffraction image analysis interfaces. It is used to define periodic lattice regions, masks, or measurement references on images, with interactive control of the u position, v position, and radius.
